_doc: PRESET: short interview, full edit (longform.py). Transcript-driven cut: pauses and um/uh removed, hand cuts, wide/tight framing that alternates at each jump cut, word-timed captions, lower third, question cards, b-roll, music bed, end card. Times: 'at_src'/'end_src' are SOURCE seconds (they follow the edit when cuts change; the studio fills them from the transcript), 'at'/'dur' are EDITED seconds. Keys starting with _ are notes.
name: interview

output._doc: aspect 9:16 | 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 (or size [w, h]). focus = [x, y] fractions of the frame to keep in view (the face). zoom > 1 crops in. rotate = degrees to level the horizon (corners are zoomed out of view).

grade._doc: Project colour, applied to every clip without its own grade. exposure in EV stops, contrast and saturation 1 = unchanged, temperature and tint -1..1 (warm/cool, magenta/green), denoise 0..1 = video grain reduction (export only, check with Stills). The studio preview uses the same maths for colour.

audio._doc: denoise and voice: off | light | medium | strong. denoise = high-pass for rumble + FFT noise reduction against the measured room noise; voice = less boom at 220 Hz, more presence at 3.2 kHz, de-essing. Applied to the whole recording before it is cut; the studio's Sound > Listen plays 10 s before/after.

export._doc: Export settings. short_side 540 | 720 | 1080 | 1440 | 2160 px; fps 24 | 25 | 30 | 50 | 60; quality high | standard | small; codec h264 (plays anywhere) | h265 (smaller); max_mbps caps the bitrate (venue players); audio_kbps; loudness in LUFS (null = leave as recorded); file = name in exports/ (default: the project name).

trim._doc: mode: words (cut pauses longer than max_gap), head_tail (only before the first / after the last word), none. lead/tail = air kept before/after speech at a cut. fillers: cut the words listed in style/signature.json longform.fillers (transcribe with --fillers so Whisper writes them out).

_clips_doc: Optional "clips": the timeline, once edited in the studio: [{in, out, transition: {type, dur}, zoom, focus, rotate, grade}] in source seconds, any order. Without it the clips come from the transcript (trim, cuts, fillers). Transitions: fade, dip_black, dip_white, wipe_left, wipe_right, slide_left, slide_up, zoom, circle.

punch._doc: alternate = switch between wide and tight (scale) at each jump cut; segments shorter than min_seg keep the framing. off = none.

captions._doc: mode: words (spoken word highlighted) | lines (subtitles) | off. Any key of style/signature.json longform.captions_words can be overridden here, e.g. uppercase, max_words, fixes {wrong: right}.

intro._doc: Title over the first seconds of footage. Remove the title to skip.

_texts_doc: Free text overlays: {text, at | at_src, dur, x, y (centre, fractions), size (fraction of height), font display | sans | mono, color white | cyan | magenta | black, box 0..1 (dark box opacity), anim_in none | fade | slide_up | slide_left | pop | type, anim_out none | fade | slide_down | slide_right | pop, anim_dur}. Graphics (lower thirds, cards, chapters, intro) also take anim: fade | slide_right | slide_left | slide_up | none.
_titles_doc: Question / statement cards over dimmed footage: {text, label, at_src, dur}. Example: {"label": "Question 1", "text": "What makes a team work?", "at_src": 12.4, "dur": 2.6}
_broll_doc: Cutaways over the speech (sound stays on the speaker): {file, at_src, end_src | dur, from}. file = photo or video; from = start second inside a video.

music._doc: Optional bed under the speech, looped, faded, ducked when someone talks. db = level. start = seconds to skip into the track. The studio finds its beats to snap cuts and text to the music.

end._doc: Closing card appended after the edit. Set to null for none.
